text_block_list.text:
After the Osaka Hai, Марузенски begins
to train
harder than ever.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
At the same time, she is worried about
Grass
Wonder and Спешл Уик, who
seem
disheartened...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Марузенски's fears are proven correct
when Grass
Wonder suffers an injury.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Марузенски can't just stand by as they
overexert
themselves, so she tells them
about the
importance of having fun.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Taking her advice, the two athletes
successfully
get back on track.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
